Eight sorting implementations checked on 1,074 exhaustive-small/seeded cases each; additional counts listed in execution. Three complete quiz Python prompts executed, including NumPy. Two intentionally defective/incomplete quiz fragments were inspected rather than run.

C/C++/Java fragments and hosted database performance examples were semantically inspected, not compiled or benchmarked. No universal timing or hardware crossover inference is made from operation counts.
Current CPython 3.14, NumPy, Rust, Java, Swift, V8 and Linux implementation claims checked against official docs/source available on 2026-10-04; future implementations can change.

Asymptotic claims require stated cost model and input preconditions. Random-pivot Lomuto selection retains its instructional implementation with an explicit distinct-key guarantee and duplicate worst-case warning.
